chapters.1.lds: The selected Church lesson connects joy with helping others walk in truth. How does support for visiting believers make a host a fellow worker for truth?
chapters.1.summary: The elder writes to Gaius, whom he loves in truth. He prays that Gaius will be healthy, as his soul prospers. Brothers have reported that Gaius walks in truth. Gaius has cared for traveling brothers, though they were strangers. They went out for the Name and took nothing from the Gentiles. Diotrephes loves to be first and refuses the elder’s messengers. He puts out of the assembly those who welcome them. Demetrius has a good report from everyone.
